title: Diffusion: adding noise
ask: A diffusion model learns to remove noise. Each cell starts as a smooth ramp, (i + j)/30. At step t, the ramp is multiplied by sqrt(1 - t/1000). Then noise times sqrt(t/1000) is added. This schedule is linear in t, for teaching. It is not the DDPM schedule.

derive.expr: sqrt(1 - t/1000) * (i + j)/30 + sqrt(t/1000) * noise(i, j)

blocks.prompt: At t = 500, the ramp is multiplied by what number?
blocks.why: Say why, in one line, before you lock in.

blocks.text: At t = 500 the ramp is multiplied by sqrt(0.5), about 0.71. The noise is multiplied by 0.71 too. Move t to 1000. Then only noise is left.
